source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1129 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1129 was established by Ordinance No. 33032, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 26, 2025. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1129 is established on property located at the northwest corner of Clark Road and Camp Wisdom Road. The size of PD 1129 is approximately 13.36 acres. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article: DEVELOPMENT BONUS PROJECT means a project obtaining a mixed income housing bonus in accordance with Section 51P-1129.113.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article:

Exhibit 1129A: development plan. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a development bonus project, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 1129A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the MU-1 Mixed Use District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MU-1 Mixed Use District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the MU-1 Mixed Use District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review
(DIR) in the MU-1 Mixed Use District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MU-1 Mixed Use District apply.

(b) Density. For a development bonus project, maximum dwelling unit density is 35 units per acre. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Design Standards For A Development Bonus
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.109. DESIGN STANDARDS FOR A DEVELOPMENT BONUS PROJECT.

(a) Applicability. The following design standards apply to a new construction for a development bonus project.

(b) Sidewalks.

(1) Unobstructed six-foot-wide sidewalks are required along all street frontages.

(2) Sidewalks must be level across all driveways, curb cuts, and entrances or exits to loading areas.

(3) Where driveways intersect with a sidewalk or pedestrian path, each driveway must be clearly marked by colored concrete, patterned or stamped concrete, or brick pavers for pedestrian crossing.

(c) Pedestrian pathways. Each street frontage must include a minimum of one pedestrian pathway directly connecting the sidewalk and internal structures described in this subsection.

(1) A minimum of one six-foot-wide unobstructed internal pedestrian pathway leading to a primary entrance of each main building is required.

(2) Pedestrian pathways along internal private drives and for crossing is required.

(3) A minimum of 80 percent of ground level dwelling units that face streets must be connected via pedestrian path to a sidewalk, and the connection point to the sidewalk may be gated.

(4) A minimum of 60 percent of ground level dwelling units that face open space must be connected via pedestrian path to a sidewalk, and the connection point to the sidewalk may be gated.

(5) When abutting parking spaces or driving surfaces, all pathways must be protected by concrete curbs, wheel stops, or other permanent barriers such that no part of a parked automobile extends into the minimum unobstructed width.

(6) When crossing a drive aisle, all pathways must be of a contrasting color, material, or texture.

(d) Pedestrian amenities. A minimum of one of the following pedestrian amenities must be provided for every 300 feet of public street frontage.

(1) Bench. (minimum of six linear feet)

(2) Trash receptacle.

(e) Required buffering. Except within a visibility triangle, where public sidewalks abut any driving surface, off-street or on-street loading area, or parking surface the following buffering is required:

(1) landscaping plantings with a minimum height of 36 inches; or

(2) bollards with a minimum height of 36 inches, spaced no more than six feet in distance from each other.

(f) Community amenities. A development bonus project must provide a minimum of one of each of the following community amenities:

(1) Swimming pool.

(2) Fitness facility for residents.

(3) Dog recreation area. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.110. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) For a development bonus project:

(1) trees within the street buffer zone must be planted at a rate of one for every 30 feet on center; and

(2) the minimum number of required landscape points is 50.

(c) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Development Bonus For Mixed Income Housing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.113. DEVELOPMENT BONUS FOR MIXED INCOME HOUSING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the development bonus identified in Section 51P-1129.108 applies if a minimum of five percent of the total number of units are made available to households earning between 61 to 80 percent of the area median family income and are in compliance with Division 51A-4.1100, as amended.

(b) Design standards. Except as provided in this section, compliance with Section 51A- 4.1107 is required.

(1) Front yard fences may be up to six feet in height.

(2) A maximum of 35 percent of surface parking provided may be located between buildings and streets in the areas shown on the development plan.

(3) Ground level dwelling units are not required to have direct connections via sidewalk to streets except to comply with the requirements of Section 51P-1129.109(c). (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.114. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 33032)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1129.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 33032)
